requirements.title: Zero mandatory paid services; local-first operation
requirements.acceptance: Core platform runs with local PostgreSQL, Ollama and Sentence Transformers only
requirements.limitation: No automated check asserts the absence of paid dependencies; verified by inspection of requirements files and the Phase 7 manual end-to-end runs.

requirements.title: Accurate Git authorship, no AI watermarks or co-author trailers
requirements.acceptance: All commits authored by the verified identity; no promotional attribution
requirements.limitation: Verified by git log inspection at each gate, not by an automated test.

requirements.title: Proprietary source-visible license present
requirements.acceptance: LICENSE file matches the approved text
requirements.limitation: Presence verified by inspection; the license has not been legally reviewed.

requirements.title: Preferred stack (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, PostgreSQL+pgvector, React/TypeScript/Vite, Pytest/Vitest/Playwright)
requirements.acceptance: Components in use and runnable

requirements.title: CPU-only inference chosen after hardware inspection
requirements.acceptance: Hardware recorded; model fits CPU/RAM
requirements.limitation: One hardware profile (i7-1165G7, 15.7 GB) only.

requirements.title: Fictional customer discovery documents
requirements.acceptance: docs/customer-discovery complete with fictional assumptions labelled
requirements.limitation: Fictional by design and labelled as assumptions; no real interviews exist; same-author documents.

requirements.title: Requirements-to-solution traceability matrix
requirements.acceptance: Every major requirement maps to need, implementation, component, test, acceptance criterion, evidence
requirements.limitation: 'Customer need' is expressed through the specification part; the fictional discovery documents (R6.1) that would supply real needs, now exist (docs/customer-discovery), but the matrix is generated from the 85-item provisional catalogue, not from all 238 requirements.

requirements.title: Apex end-to-end workflow (report -> evidence-grounded explanation -> structured issue -> ticket -> approval -> mock submission -> external id -> audit -> metrics)
requirements.acceptance: All 14 workflow steps demonstrated through the real API and UI
requirements.limitation: Real-AI runs show the review gate sends a large share of incidents to a human (about 75% in the Phase 3/4 data).

requirements.title: Meridian end-to-end workflow as a separate tenant through configuration only
requirements.acceptance: All Meridian workflow steps demonstrated; no Meridian-specific code in shared services
requirements.limitation: Apex and Meridian retain two execution paths (documented technical debt).

requirements.title: Modular monolith with background worker; PostgreSQL authoritative state; pgvector retrieval; transactional outbox
requirements.acceptance: Single deployable API + worker; outbox events drive submission

requirements.title: Core modules: auth, tenants, configuration, connectors, ingestion, retrieval, AI, incidents, workflow, audit, observability, evaluation, dashboard
requirements.acceptance: Each module exists and is exercised
requirements.limitation: Evaluation is a set of scripts and artifacts plus a read-only dashboard, not a managed service (see R21.x).

requirements.title: New customer configurable without modifying the core application
requirements.acceptance: Tenant onboarded through public APIs and configuration only

requirements.title: Customer-specific schema/field mappings and workflow policies
requirements.acceptance: CSV/JSON mappings, categories, signals, priority rules and ticketing contract configured per tenant

requirements.title: Configuration validation and onboarding health checks
requirements.acceptance: Invalid profiles rejected; health checks derived from real configuration

requirements.title: Tenant creation, membership and role assignment
requirements.acceptance: Platform admin creates tenants; tenant admins manage members; no self-escalation

requirements.title: Reusable connectors for mock CRM, inventory, ticketing and REST APIs; mock APIs with configurable failures
requirements.acceptance: Connectors work against local mocks; mocks inject 503/429/timeout/malformed/lost-response/400

requirements.title: Timeouts, retries, exponential backoff, error classification
requirements.acceptance: Transient vs permanent classification; bounded timeouts; backoff and dead-letter

requirements.title: Idempotency
requirements.acceptance: A lost response and replays create exactly one external ticket

requirements.title: CSV, webhook connectors, connector authentication, pagination, rate limiting, schema validation, health checks
requirements.acceptance: Each capability implemented and tested
requirements.limitation: Connector health reports configuration and delivery results, not a live probe. CSV/webhook connector kinds exist as names only; pagination and per-connector rate limiting are not implemented; authentication is an API-key header.

requirements.title: Ingestion of PDF, CSV and JSON with parsing, normalization and validation
requirements.acceptance: Supported types ingested into passages; unsupported types and oversize files refused
requirements.limitation: REST API records and webhook payloads as ingestion sources are not implemented.

requirements.title: Content hashing, duplicate detection, version tracking, idempotent concurrent ingestion
requirements.acceptance: Identical content reported duplicate; changed content becomes a new version; races resolve safely

requirements.title: Source provenance (page numbers, record identifiers)
requirements.acceptance: Every passage carries page or record id and is cited with it

requirements.title: Reprocessing and reindexing
requirements.acceptance: Atomic reindex between embedding models with verification

requirements.title: Document deletion and retry handling for ingestion jobs
requirements.acceptance: Documents can be deleted; ingestion jobs retried

requirements.title: Chunking, embeddings, vector index, full-text search, hybrid retrieval, tenant-aware filtering
requirements.acceptance: Hybrid retrieval returns only the tenant's current passages
requirements.limitation: Recall@5 saturates on the small synthetic corpus; optional reranking (R13.5) is not implemented.

requirements.title: Evidence-grounded answers with citation generation and verification
requirements.acceptance: Every citation is a verbatim quote of a current tenant-owned passage; unsupported identifiers and numbers are withheld
requirements.limitation: Citation correctness: 89.3-92.6% (Phase 3/4, 95% target NOT MET); on the Phase 8 development split 85.7% baseline and 91.9% with the development candidate (NOT MET); held-out evaluation not yet run.

requirements.title: Insufficient-evidence handling; never fabricate citations
requirements.acceptance: Out-of-scope questions get an insufficient-evidence response with no citations
requirements.limitation: 6 of 8 unanswerable questions refused in the Phase 3/4 measurements; on the Phase 8 development split correct abstention 60.9% baseline and 95.7% (22/23) with the development candidate (dev only, observed target met, interval overlaps); held-out evaluation not yet run.

requirements.title: Retrieved documents treated as untrusted; model text cannot authorize actions
requirements.acceptance: Prompt-injection passages quarantined; no action created from document text

requirements.title: Optional reranking
requirements.acceptance: Reranker available
requirements.limitation: Deliberately not built; a reranker needs approval (governance) and an evaluation.

requirements.title: Local inference with Ollama and Sentence Transformers
requirements.acceptance: Approved models run locally and are pinned
requirements.limitation: Only qwen2.5:1.5b and all-MiniLM-L6-v2 were evaluated.

requirements.title: Validated structured incident schema (tenant, asset, category, symptoms, related incidents, priority, citations, recommended action, review status)
requirements.acceptance: Model output must validate; invalid output falls back or is rejected
requirements.limitation: Extraction schema validity 23/24 on the Phase 3/4 report set (one hallucinated asset rejected).

requirements.title: Related (historical) incident matching
requirements.acceptance: Same-asset history listed first from the tenant's own records

requirements.title: Deterministic business rules for priority
requirements.acceptance: Priority never decided by the model
requirements.limitation: Priority depends on the model-extracted category (observed to change priority in the Meridian smoke run).

requirements.title: Numeric measurements used for priority are traceable to the report (value, unit, source, evidence span, status); unsupported values are never accepted as verified
requirements.acceptance: V8 trust policy (supersedes the V7 wording below): free-text and LLM values are unverified candidates; only signed-simulation or human-verified observations are eligible. Earlier V7 layer: a model-proposed measurement is used only when the report states it with the right unit for the incident's own asset, without a contradicting reading and outside instruction-like text; otherwise it is quarantined with the reason recorded and the incident is held for human review; genuine values and real P1 incidents are unchanged
requirements.limitation: Author-built evidence only: V8 architecture: only signed-simulation or human-verified observations drive numeric priority; the frozen safety-v8 run (kept as FAILED) met every safety gate except complete priority-decision provenance (63/64); a targeted provenance-envelope closure was then verified by targeted and regression tests only; class E (authenticated sensor) not implemented; the model itself still hallucinates numbers.

requirements.title: Questions that name an identifier absent from the cited evidence, or that try to override the evidence/tenant/approval rules, are refused
requirements.acceptance: Entity gate and override gate refuse such questions without raising false refusals
requirements.limitation: Development split only (23 unanswerable queries, 0 false refusals on 87 answerable); gate patterns were written against dev phrasing; off by default; attribute mix-ups (right model, wrong parameter) are not caught.

requirements.title: Review status and human-review gate
requirements.acceptance: needs_review blocks ticketing; acceptance never verifies unsupported claims; unregistered assets blocked before release
requirements.limitation: About 75% of incidents require human review with the approved model (operational limitation, intentionally not relaxed).

requirements.title: Human approval before external submission; rejected tickets never submitted; retries cannot bypass approval
requirements.acceptance: No external call without a recorded approval; worker re-verifies

requirements.title: Role-based approval and separation of duties
requirements.acceptance: Only supervisors/admins decide; authors cannot approve their own ticket

requirements.title: Idempotent submission and duplicate prevention
requirements.acceptance: At most one external ticket per ticket under retries, lost responses and concurrency

requirements.title: Retry and recovery
requirements.acceptance: Transient failures recover automatically; permanent failures are reported and manually retryable

requirements.title: Nine ticket states, valid transitions, editable drafts, recorded decisions, audit history
requirements.acceptance: State machine enforced; every transition audited

requirements.title: Concurrent approvals tested
requirements.acceptance: Eight simultaneous approvals produce one winner

requirements.title: Tenant authorization, tenant-aware retrieval, row-level security
requirements.acceptance: Zero successful cross-tenant accesses across APIs, retrieval, workflows and external systems
requirements.limitation: The tenant context is trusted application input; a fully compromised application process could set it (documented in identity-tables.md).

requirements.title: Authentication, RBAC for the five roles, negative authorization tests on every route
requirements.acceptance: Role x route matrix has zero violations

requirements.title: Secure credential handling and no committed secrets
requirements.acceptance: Secrets only by environment reference; secret scan clean; test credentials confined and refused in production
requirements.limitation: Pattern/known-value scan only, not a history-wide scanner.

requirements.title: Input validation and upload restrictions; rate limiting
requirements.acceptance: Typed validation, size and type limits, bounded concurrency, login throttle
requirements.limitation: Throttling and limits are per process; distributed rate limiting is required before production.

requirements.title: Audit logging (append-only)
requirements.acceptance: Every consequential action recorded; trail cannot be altered

requirements.title: Outbound connector security (SSRF)
requirements.acceptance: No tenant-configurable connector can reach an unauthorized destination on any execution path
requirements.limitation: Application-level only; network-level egress restrictions are required in production.

requirements.title: Prompt-injection defenses
requirements.acceptance: Poisoned passages quarantined

requirements.title: Required API namespaces, typed contracts, pagination, standardized errors, OpenAPI
requirements.acceptance: All required namespaces exist and are covered by the route table

requirements.title: Migrations, transactions, constraints, indexes
requirements.acceptance: Alembic migrations 0001-0008 apply cleanly (0008 verified up/down/reapply on a disposable database); constraints prove invariants; every tenant-scoped table has a tenant-leading index

requirements.title: Required database entities (including ingestion jobs, evaluation runs, workflow executions, roles table)
requirements.acceptance: All listed entities exist
requirements.limitation: Implemented: tenants, users, memberships, connectors, documents, versions, chunks (embeddings), incidents, tickets, approvals, outbox events, audit events, profiles. Not implemented as tables: roles (string column), ingestion jobs, evaluation runs (file artifacts), workflow executions (outbox events serve).

requirements.title: 13 required pages on React/TypeScript/Vite using real backend data
requirements.acceptance: All 13 pages render against the real backend without console errors

requirements.title: Responsive layout, loading/empty/error states, search, filtering, pagination, form validation
requirements.acceptance: States exist and no horizontal overflow at 375 px

requirements.title: Accessibility
requirements.acceptance: No critical or serious automated violations; keyboard-operable critical workflow
requirements.limitation: 43 states audited with axe (0 violations), Edge only; no screen-reader audit; WCAG conformance is not claimed.

requirements.title: No fabricated metrics displayed
requirements.acceptance: Evaluation and overview figures come from artifacts or tenant records; targets labelled as targets

requirements.title: Customer A acceptance tests UAT-A01 to UAT-A08 with JSON and Markdown reports
requirements.acceptance: All eight pass in deterministic and real-AI modes
requirements.limitation: AI-dependent acceptance (A02-A04) rests on the real-model run, which uses an explicit threshold (2 of 3 grounded answers).

requirements.title: Customer B acceptance tests UAT-B01 to UAT-B07
requirements.acceptance: All seven pass in deterministic and real-AI modes
requirements.limitation: Meridian has no AI-quality benchmark (Phase 8).

requirements.title: FI-01 HTTP 503 outage
requirements.acceptance: Retried automatically, one external ticket

requirements.title: FI-02 HTTP 429 rate limiting
requirements.acceptance: Retried automatically, one external ticket

requirements.title: FI-03 Network timeout
requirements.acceptance: Timeout classified transient; no duplicate

requirements.title: FI-04 Malformed API response
requirements.acceptance: Replay with the idempotency key creates no second ticket

requirements.title: FI-05 Unauthorized cross-tenant access
requirements.acceptance: 40 attempts, 0 successes

requirements.title: FI-06 Concurrent approvals
requirements.acceptance: One winner among 8 concurrent approvals

requirements.title: FI-07 Worker interruption
requirements.acceptance: Lease expiry lets another worker resume; one external ticket

requirements.title: FI-08 Prompt injection
requirements.acceptance: Poisoned content quarantined; nothing created

requirements.title: FI-09 Duplicate ingestion
requirements.acceptance: One stored copy under sequential and concurrent uploads

requirements.title: FI-10 Database interruption
requirements.acceptance: API 503, no external call, replay after restart, one ticket
requirements.limitation: Disruptive: stops the project's own PostgreSQL container; opt-in (RUN_DISRUPTIVE=1).

requirements.title: Additional dependency failures: LLM timeout/failure, embedding failure, invalid structured output, API restart
requirements.acceptance: Honest withholding, 503 not 500, human-review fallback, no state lost
requirements.limitation: These are REL-01 to REL-04, separate from the specification's FI identifiers.

requirements.title: Retrieval and generation metrics on labelled data (Recall@5, precision, citation correctness, groundedness, structured validity)
requirements.acceptance: Reported with denominators, methodology and actual measurements
requirements.limitation: Single small synthetic dataset, author-written labels, no confidence intervals; 95% citation target NOT MET; harder multi-tenant dataset planned for Phase 8.

requirements.title: Workflow, integration, recovery and isolation measures
requirements.acceptance: Workflow completion, duplicates, recovery and isolation reported

requirements.title: Latency measurements (API, retrieval, LLM, end-to-end) with hardware recorded
requirements.acceptance: Median and p95 reported with hardware, model and repetitions
requirements.limitation: Local single-machine measurements; the observability metrics are process-scoped.

requirements.title: Manual-versus-automated comparison labelled as a simulated baseline
requirements.acceptance: Comparison with clear labelling
requirements.limitation: Not produced; planned for Phase 8.

requirements.title: Structured JSON logging, correlation ids, no secrets or sensitive content in logs
requirements.acceptance: Every request line has a correlation id; credentials, tokens and document text never appear

requirements.title: Tenant-aware operational metrics (latency, retries, failures, review rate, submission outcomes, error classes)
requirements.acceptance: Metrics scoped to the tenant; no sensitive content
requirements.limitation: Process metrics reset on restart and cover only the API process; worker activity is durable only through the database and logs. Not production telemetry.

requirements.title: OpenTelemetry traces; optional Prometheus and Grafana
requirements.acceptance: Trace ids exported
requirements.limitation: Correlation ids exist; no OpenTelemetry or Prometheus exporter is implemented (optional per the specification).

requirements.title: Reproducible local deployment with Docker Compose
requirements.acceptance: A single documented command starts the stack
requirements.limitation: docker-compose.yml runs PostgreSQL for development; docker-compose.app.yml builds and runs the whole stack in containers (smoke-tested twice) with the deterministic AI backends only. Ollama integration from inside a container is untested.

requirements.title: Cloud portability documentation and Terraform/OpenTofu examples
requirements.acceptance: Documented and validated where feasible
requirements.limitation: The Terraform example passed local schema validation with AWS 5.100.0 on Windows amd64. Cloud portability mappings are design analysis. No cloud deployment was attempted.

requirements.title: Customer-facing technical communication
requirements.acceptance: Delivery documents complete
requirements.limitation: Ten delivery documents, walkthrough script, diagrams and runbook for FICTIONAL customers; same-author documents; the walkthrough has not been presented.

requirements.title: Automated tests: backend, frontend, e2e, security, fault injection, acceptance
requirements.acceptance: All suites pass

requirements.title: CI/CD with GitHub Actions within free allowances
requirements.acceptance: Workflow runs and passes in CI
requirements.limitation: The workflow file exists but has never run: nothing is pushed.

requirements.title: README with a verified-results table (metric, actual, target, command, evidence)
requirements.acceptance: Every row is a measured result with a command and an evidence path
requirements.limitation: Updated at each phase gate by hand; not machine-checked against the artifacts.

requirements.title: Complete end-to-end demonstration reproducible
requirements.acceptance: Scripted demo reproducible by a third party
requirements.limitation: The 27-step demo script is a Phase 10 deliverable; the same flows are automated.

requirements.title: Final GitHub audit and publication
requirements.acceptance: Authorized publication of a tested release
requirements.limitation: Publication is a separate approval gate; nothing has been pushed or released.

requirements.title: Definition of done checklist
requirements.acceptance: All 37 items satisfied
requirements.limitation: Items 20-25, 27, 35-37 and parts of 18, 21, 28 remain open (Docker deployment, CI, cloud portability, discovery and handover documents, publication).
